text: [R009, variable-channel four-state capacity](../findings/R009-variable-channel-capacity.md), is accepted after separate proof and final significance reviews. The independently audited locally finite strengthening belongs to the same finding. The current count is **3 accepted, 7 remaining**; the [count and continuation ledger](../TEN-FINDINGS.md) is authoritative.

The parent accepts R009 as the third substantial deduction under the pinned corpus. The contribution is the uniform local moment and flow-splitting sufficiency proof for arbitrary edge channels, including channels approaching or equal to perfect transmission. The final contribution audit recommends acceptance after checking variable-interaction Ising, Potts and robust-reconstruction literature and proposed standard reductions. Capacity formalism and the near-perfect ray example are not claimed as new.

After R006, the user requested: “Come up with new one - keep make a progress.” The resulting search now accepts R008 as a second substantial, plausible new deduction under the stipulated corpus and bounded novelty assessment. Independent proof and final significance reviews support that decision; worldwide priority remains unverified. The three research lanes have these final dispositions:

It yields parity 1/2 in every fixed reduced progression, independent of PD(1) and squarefreeness. The original candidate is retained unchanged as the reviewed artifact. This is one finding, including the Möbius-sign consequences.

Decision: commit R008 separately as a validated deduction under the stipulated corpus. A fresh final novelty/significance review checks stronger source interfaces, older results and newer versions of the overlapping public claim before the second substantial-discovery gate is accepted. The mathematical audit supports a nonroutine advance, but worldwide priority is not certified. Gaussian review and cubic-reservoir work continue independently.

The parent reproduced both result files, checked the actual accepted Hecke strip/logarithmic-control contract and the classical reciprocity source, and verified 52 source files (42 pinned) and 26 artifacts. Only the shared index input changed. The [parent decision](../sources/i06_cubic_reservoir/parent-decision.md) records the scope, including why the finite theta diagnostics cannot support the tiny-theta asymptotic. Decision: preserve this partial progress without adding a finding; park the lane at RP/MT-lower. The final novelty/significance review of the mathematically accepted R008 remains active.

The fresh final review recommends accepting R008 as a substantial nonroutine deduction beyond R006. It screened the complete inventory and inspected stronger quantitative and qualitative multiplicative-correlation interfaces, the exact D/E/S contracts, and current primary prior art. It found no direct stronger theorem supplying LP and no new proof-critical problem. Carella's latest listed v3 explicitly makes its main scalar cancellation theorems conditional on a shifted-prime distribution hypothesis; this supersedes relying on v1 criticism alone. Shift-averaged and Siegel-zero-conditional results do not supply the fixed-predecessor joint theorem under these premises.

The parent read the full review, checked the decisive current-version statements, and verified 52 download hashes, 36 pinned Git blobs, 34 source ranges and 25 page extracts. Only this shared index had changed among recorded inputs before integration; see [verification](../sources/i05_parity_novelty_r3/parent-verification.json). R008 now contains the final scope, corrections and named consequence.

Decision: the second substantive-discovery objective is met by R008 on the qualified accepted-corpus basis. It is one finding, already committed separately for mathematical acceptance, with this final-review integration completing its significance assessment. Worldwide priority, independent validation of upstream truth, external peer review and formal certification are not claimed. Gaussian and cubic lanes remain respectively demoted and unclosed; neither is counted toward success. No further task is launched or publication attempted.

The independent proof audit passes the complete chain RC → interior AP → fixed-progression PD/reservoir → positive-proportion primitive roots. It found no unresolved analytic gap under the accepted corpus. The parent corrected the normalization typo, equation-label descriptions, and GEM wording, and made explicit the required reassembly of physical dyads and the Mellin integral before shared-label mixing. The full-small-interval hypothesis and fixed-modulus quantifiers are retained. The result is accepted as [R006](../findings/R006-progression-PD-primitive-root-density.md).

The author output reproduced byte for byte. Independent exact checks passed 12,950,254 orbit cases, 1,560 reassembled stripping models, 17,892 CRT cases and 717,544 perturbed-law error cases. The parent verified 60 pinned sources, five literature downloads, 12 fresh source copies and 26 reviewer artifacts; the [verification record](../sources/i03_arithmetic_progressions_r4/parent-verification.json) predates editorial integration. Finite checks support algebra and source integrity, not asymptotic proof or novelty. The audit's unsupported MathDB attribution is corrected in R006; the quantitative comparison comes from the actual source manuscript P.

**Decision:** accept R006 as satisfying the substantial/nonroutine research target under the explicitly assumed pinned premises and the bounded novelty assessment. Do not claim a certified worldwide-first proof, a natural-density limit, the Artin constant, or established unconditional mathematics independent of those premises. This concludes the requested discovery iteration with one substantial plausible new deduction; R007 remains a separate validated negative construction result. Historical pending or failed exploratory records do not become accepted findings by this decision. No publication, external submission or priority registration was performed.

The [i05 report](i05-joint-artin.md) supplies proposed complete proofs of simultaneous indices dividing 2 for every finite set of integer bases of absolute value at least 2, and indices dividing 3 under the exact quadratic compatibility condition. Both reuse R006's reservoir and tail argument routinely, and neither is counted as the requested second substantial result. The algebraic quadratic/cubic compatibility criterion is already Moree–Stevenhagen's Theorem 6.2; the parent read the actual theorem and adjacent proof.

### I38 accepted as R012; sixth substantial finding

The [final R3 review](../reviews/i38-propeller-stability-novelty-r3.md) recommends **SUBSTANTIAL**, preserving R2's **original-proof PASS without repairs**. The parent accepts [R012 — uniform Gaussian propeller stability](../findings/R012-uniform-gaussian-propeller-stability.md) as the **sixth substantial finding**. Its one positive constant is independent of ambient dimension, finite label count and cell masses; the distance exponent 1/2 is sharp. The implicit constant is not claimed effective or optimal. All mass-concentration consequences count as this same result.

The acceptance record preserves the full theorem, source dependencies, proof outline, constants, review decisions and novelty limits. The result is not described as the first quantitative propeller theorem or a sharp-constant theorem. [I39 quantum/spectral discovery](iteration39-quantum-spectral-discovery-task.json) now screens fresh area-law, Haldane and spin-glass/spectral consequences, requiring a substantive new mechanism rather than routine gap or compactness transfers. The ten-finding objective remains active: **six accepted, four remaining**.

The [completed I39 report](i39-quantum-spectral-discovery.md) is a **developed gap record**, with no substantial nomination. Its selected target H asks for a positive gap uniform over every sufficiently small scalar bond-disorder profile on all sufficiently long even spin-one Heisenberg rings. Both a disordered transfer/purity route and a local-energy/dressing route leave H **unproved and not refuted**.

The parent read the full report and verifier, checked the Gaussian warming statement and the opening strong-semigroup/weak-density interfaces in the quench source, and reproduced [both commands](../experiments/i39-parent-verification.json). Checks pass for 258 sealed artifacts, 163 frozen inputs, 159 selected source files in ten manuscripts, 28 successful responses including eight fresh identical pinned responses, ten versioned primary papers, 34 read records and 389 exact assertions. All 9,340 corpus files match the complete 749-manuscript inventory; the project screen covers 158 Markdown files. Two mutable ledger changes and the previously recorded removal of one trailing newline from R012 remain explicitly separated from proof dependencies. The diagnostics are exact finite checks, not independent analytic acceptance of the new partial deductions.
### I50 integration and R013 acceptance: seventh substantial finding

[R013 — higher-dimensional logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski stability](../findings/R013-higher-dimensional-logarithmic-stability.md) is accepted as the **seventh substantial finding**. The [completed I50 audit](../reviews/i50-hard-moment-quantitative-stability-r2.md) gives **H49 PASS ORIGINAL WITHOUT REPAIRS**, covering the original dimension-only exponent and all stated quantifiers. This satisfies [I51’s substantiality verdict](../reviews/i51-hard-moment-quantitative-stability-novelty.md), which was explicitly conditional on original-proof approval. The complete proof remains unchanged in I49; no strengthened hypothesis, different exponent or replacement construction was needed.

Fresh T3 tasks [I52](iteration52-ergodic-dynamical-discovery-task.json) and [I53](iteration53-sharp-entropy-stability-discovery-task.json) continue the user’s ten-finding objective. I52 screens the ergodic/dynamical source cluster, including multiple averages, billiards and standard-map entropy. I53 starts from the actual sharp entropy/simplex manuscript and seeks quantitative mechanisms beyond its already retained slack and equality proof. Each must screen at least three candidates, develop its strongest route through two constructions, check current primary antecedents and preserve exact scope. Neither task may count routine consequences of R013 or other accepted findings. Each owns only its dedicated report, source and experiment paths.

The parent agrees with the technical-only disposition after reading the full report and both decisive source operations. In the polymatroid source, the tight rank normals of each matroid are already spanned by a chain. At strictly fractional coordinates each chain has at most r members and the two spans share the total-set normal, giving active rank at most 2r−1. The matching entropy source's finite-support covariance trace argument then applies directly: at a positive defect maximum it gives 0 ≥ d−n+(1+c)r. Contraction/deletion of coordinates equal to one/zero and a strict perturbation c=1−1/R+ε produce the contradiction on every boundary face. Even-cycle partition pairs attain the coefficient, so sharpness adds no new separator mechanism. No hard-intersection log-concavity or R011 graph analogy is assumed.
